name: Aniruddh Bhilvare
title: Staff Software Engineer
tagline: Thirteen years across mobile and backend engineering, now building AI tooling that changes how teams get from requirements to running code.
about: My career splits roughly in half. The first decade was mobile, building Android and iOS applications at Ecosmob, Netrix, and YUJ Designs, including a SIP/VoIP client for enterprise customers and a connected-vehicle app for Citroën. Since then I've worked mainly on the backend: multi-tenant SaaS platforms, event-driven services on AWS, and the data models underneath them.

For the past two years I've also been working on agentic engineering, an internal initiative at Particle41 designing AI-powered developer tooling that includes an "Agentic Software Factory" for generating working applications directly from product requirement documents. The interesting problems there aren't prompt tricks; they're orchestration, evaluation, and knowing which parts of the software lifecycle genuinely benefit from delegation to a model.
Along the way I've led teams of up to 8 engineers and set the standards for system design, clean architecture, and code review.
